_doc: FileIntoNewMailbox creates a mailbox and moves a message into it, referring to the mailbox by its creation id before the server has assigned a real one. Carrying the creation ids in and out lets a proxy split this across servers, or a client continue in a second request, with the reference still resolving.

methodCalls._comment: "#box" is the mailbox above. Had it been created by an earlier request instead, the creation ids passed in would resolve it just the same.
